name: SCO Dimension of Trivial Concepts
proof: For the two constant concepts, the established spherical dimension is $0$, so the SCO lower bound gives $\mathrm{SCO}\geq\mathrm{sd}+1=1$. Their established sign rank is $1$, and the sign-rank SCO reduction gives $\mathrm{SCO}\leq1$. Thus the value is exactly one.
